notes: Harker Experi(Mental): 18 teams, guillotine, and the only league with IDP. The 2025 draft cleared its defensive players between rounds 7 and 11, peaking at 8-11, which is what these deadlines are built around. Caveat: only 42% of that draft's Yahoo player ids resolved to positions, and defensive players are the ones most likely to be missing, so the real IDP concentration may start earlier than it looks.

rules.label: RB-RB start
rules.note: Eighteen teams means replacement level is brutal everywhere. Anchor the backfield first.

rules.label: Two linebackers by round 16
rules.note: Linebackers are the deepest and most valuable IDP group in this scoring (2 per solo tackle, 1 per assist), and they were the most-drafted IDP position in rounds 7-11 last year. Being the last team without one in an 18-team league is expensive. The slot is doubled, so one linebacker leaves a starting place empty. The first goes where the market takes them in rounds 7 to 11; the second can wait, but not past the bench rounds.

rules.label: Two defensive linemen by round 17
rules.note: Sacks pay 6 here, so the top edge rushers carry real weekly upside. They went a round or so after the linebackers in 2025. Second lineman for the second slot. Sacks pay six here, so even the back half of the position has weekly upside worth owning.

rules.label: Two defensive backs by round 18
rules.note: The flattest of the three groups — safeties who play every snap are close to interchangeable, so this is the one to leave latest. The flattest group and therefore the one to leave latest, but two slots still have to be filled before the draft runs out.

rules.label: QB after the top two
rules.note: Not paying up for Josh Allen or Lamar Jackson.

rules.label: No one who will not play
rules.note: Elimination is weekly, so a pick that does not play in September may never play for you at all. Anyone carrying a real absence is kept off the board here. Questionable is not: fifty-nine ranked players carry it in August, McCaffrey and Chase among them, and acting on it would delete the top of the board — it is shown and left to you.

rules.label: Kicker last
rules.note: No team defence in this league — the D slot takes a defensive player, not a unit — so the kicker is the only mandatory pick left at the end.

note: No late-target rule here, unlike the other three leagues. Rookies and handcuffs are season-long bets, and this league eliminates the lowest scorer every week — a handcuff pays off in a week you may not reach, and the pool of eliminated teams' players hits waivers anyway, so bench depth is cheaper to buy later than to draft. Every pick has to score from week one.
